newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - April 17.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - April 17.

text.p: The Federal Reserve had two large one day net misses in its reserve projections in the latest week, a Fed spokeswoman said.
The first miss occured on Tuesday, while the second miss occured on Wednesday.
Both misses were due to fewer reserves in the banking system because treasury deposits at the Federal Reserve were much higher than anticipated.
The high in natural float was a bit over $850 million on Wednesday, while the low in natural float occurred on Monday at a bit under $50 million.
Transporation float averaged about $25 million per day with the high on Thursday at a bit over $75 million primarily due aircraft mechanical problems in the New York area.
